statements.notes:
Read the entire label and follow the directions carefully prior to use.
DIRECTIONS: Take one (1) capsule 20-30 minutes before each meal not exceeding three capsules daily, or as recommended by a healthcare practitioner. Each serving contains approximately 11 mg of caffeine (the amount found in 1/4 cup brewed green tea).
